thread.title: Alex Jones gets scrubbed from internet, mercilessly parodied on ‘Late Show’ - MarketWatch

author: Shawn Langlois
title: Alex Jones gets scrubbed from internet, mercilessly parodied on ‘Late Show’ - MarketWatch
text:
Stephen Colbert, a longtime lampooner of Alex Jones, could hardly contain his merriment on Tuesday night’s “The Late Show” over the fate of “the extreme right-wing conspiracy theorist and bath salts spokesmodel,” saying “it looks like his website Infowars just lost their war on info.”
‘Now if you want to see one of Jones’s signature rants, you’ll have to be in the next booth at Ruby Tuesday’s when he sees a mother breastfeeding.’ The late-night host was talking about the move by Apple AAPL, +0.05% , YouTube GOOGL, +0.70% , Facebook FB, +1.13% and the like to purge Jones and Infowars content from their websites .
That content has, over the years, included repeated claims that the Sandy Hook elementary school shooting was a hoax and that yogurt seller Chobani imports migrant rapists, to name just a couple.
Later in the segment, Colbert, who was once called out by Jones in court , revived talk-show host Tuck Buckford, a character also facing a social-media ban at “the hands of Silicon Valley snow boys and soy flakes.”
